title: Crashes and lost canvases recorded so far
blurb: Every way a page of this project has crashed the tab or lost its canvases, one entry each: what was done, what happened, on which browser, how it was established, where to reproduce it and what the pages do now. Each entry copies as a bug report.
question: Which calls crash the renderer or lose canvas contexts when HTML-in-canvas is used, and what is the evidence for each?
result: Thirteen entries on 2026-11-21, ten with a standalone reproduction page. Five of those pages crash headless Chromium 157 when their button is pressed. Two context losses were reported from Chrome 159 on Android with the call identified.
